study_identification_part.si_4_title: Regional, circuit and network heterogeneity of brain abnormalities in psychiatric disorders

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II, ASRB, IMpACT, and TOP were used as part of the 14 multisite datasets for normative model training (HCs) and testing (HCs and cases). HCP was used as an independent sample for functional circuit mapping. Other datasets used include FEMS, MON, OCDPG, SPAINOCD, YoDA, KANMDD, MITASD, RUSMDD, and WASHASD.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We examined data for 1,465 HCs ... and 1,294 cases, taken from 14 different studies... ABIDE I... ABIDE II... ASRB... IMpACT-NL... TOP15... HCP dataset is available in the Human Connectome Project repository... mapped using an independent cohort of 150 resting-state functional MRI (rs-fMRI) scans... from the S900 release of the Human Connectome Project
